title: Anping Tree House

terrainReference.basis: Original ground directly south of the former warehouse group on the merchant-house approach.

mapIdentity.provider: Named native precinct and mapped wooden walking routes, with an original estimated warehouse envelope.
mapIdentity.scope: The named Anping Tree House precinct, separate Tait merchant house and both mapped wooden paths define site identity and surroundings. The estimated outline places the five warehouse sections immediately north of the merchant house with the published total warehouse area of roughly 1,322 m².

note: The city operator describes banyans growing through the former warehouse walls and roof and the elevated wooden walkways. The restoration architect’s interview records five warehouse sections, three banyan groups, three square black mesh lookout platforms, and remnants of red brick and granite openings.
